findings.message: Potential subdomain takeover: blog.example.com points at GitHub Pages (sajid.github.io) and the service was not probed, so it is not known whether the subdomain is claimed. A CNAME to a takeover-prone service that nobody owns can be claimed by an attacker.
findings.fix: Run with --probe to confirm, or check the GitHub Pages account for blog.example.com. Claim the subdomain by adding it to a GitHub Pages site, or remove the CNAME.
